title: Overview

grounding_quotes.text:
Metronome offers targeted solutions for invoicing to provide best-in-class support for each billing motion and distribution channel its clients support:

* **Stripe Invoicing:** Metronome natively integrates with Stripe to support client's invoicing needs. Integrate with Stripe invoicing and take advantage of Stripe Tax, dunning, and other features within the Stripe product suite.
* **Marketplace Invoicing:** Metronome's out-of-the-box integration that automates the metering to and creation of invoices in AWS, Azure, and GCP. This integration supports all charge types in Metronome - enabling you to launch a new pricing plan and immediately make it available via marketplace distribution channels. No third-party integrator required.
* **ERP Invoicing:** Metronome provides out-of-the-box and custom integrations to ERPs. Optimized for clients that bill their SLG business or execute revenue workflows inside of ERPs. Seamlessly sync transactions for collection and close your books, complaint with ASC 606 guidelines.
grounding_quotes.supports: The three invoicing solution categories and their documented capabilities.

grounding_quotes.text: With Metronome, you do not need to choose. Use each capability as it makes sense for your business.
grounding_quotes.supports: The documented option to use invoicing capabilities according to business needs.

overview: Metronome describes three invoicing solution categories: Stripe Invoicing, Marketplace Invoicing, and ERP Invoicing. The documented integrations cover Stripe features, marketplace metering and invoice creation for AWS, Azure, and GCP, and ERP billing and revenue workflows. Metronome presents these capabilities as options that organizations can use according to their business needs.
key_takeaways: Metronome offers Stripe, marketplace, and ERP invoicing solutions.
Stripe Invoicing natively integrates with Stripe and is described as supporting Stripe Tax, dunning, and other Stripe product-suite features.
Marketplace Invoicing automates metering and invoice creation for AWS, Azure, and GCP Marketplaces and supports all Metronome charge types.
ERP Invoicing includes out-of-the-box and custom ERP integrations for collection and book-closing workflows.
Organizations can use each invoicing capability according to their business needs.
